payout_quote: Earn $150* this summer ... Three steps to your $150 ... A $150 bonus will be deposited into the new checking account within 10 days after the end of the second full statement cycle if at least one qualifying direct deposit (of $500 or more) or any auto-pay withdrawal has posted to the new checking account during either of the first two full monthly statement cycles after account opening. Offer effective 7/27/2026 – 9/30/2026.
steps: Start the application online at https://www.fortifibank.com/earn-150/ and finish opening a qualifying checking account (Simple Checking, Checking Plus Cash, Checking Plus Interest, or Loyalty Plus Checking) at a Fortifi branch.
During either of the first two full monthly statement cycles, post at least one qualifying direct deposit of $500+ or any auto-pay withdrawal to the new account.
The $150 bonus lands in the account within 10 days after the end of the second full statement cycle.
catches: Account opening is completed at a Fortifi branch (Wisconsin); the online form only starts the application.
Must not have had an open Fortifi Bank personal checking account within the past 120 days; limit one new account per household.
